callerWindow.boundary: Current complete caller bytes authenticate the selected call/loop program; unsupported earlier SIMD/atomic decode is not promoted.

evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected native inputs, caller/callee metadata and method pointers, current caller body hash and complete selected local instruction bytes.
evidenceBoundary.direct: ApplyBlowOff is declared Boolean; the selected ordinary return program increments its loop index and replaces EAX with the loop count before the checked local back edge. It consumes no returned AL/EAX/RAX value.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Execution reaches this local program and the named call returns ordinarily. Receiver identity and surrounding branch feasibility remain separate.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Accepted movement/replacement/armor effects and the action overall Boolean result. No full SIMD/atomic/body decode or gameplay success is inferred.
